verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own rollback docs confirm you can roll back a Worker to a previously deployed version using Wrangler or the dashboard, so the core capability is first-party. The evidence does not show that the rollback is a single click or that every past version is eligible. missing for 10: explicit one-click dashboard flow, confirmation that any previous version (no retention limit) can be targeted, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click

citations.quote: You can roll back to a previously deployed version of your Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard.
